ops.comment: Omega bends over to start sequence

int.text: Death RX 7
Alert. Omega Restraint is offline.
Alert. Alert! Omega Restraint two is now offline. Prisoner designate: Omega Supreme is unsecured.
Warpath, slow down!
Great -- the Decepticons are locking down! Why'd you bring this kid, Optimus?

fra.text: Génial... Les Decepticons ferment la boutique ! Pourquoi tu as amené ce gamin, Optimus ?

int.text: Optimus! The floor's collapsi-i-ing!
Dial it down a notch kid.
They're torturing the poor fella.
Wonder how THAT happened?
Hey, Warpath! Watch how a pro deals with these creeps!
Ha! Look at mine fallin' down!

fra.text: Ah ! Regarde ! Je les démolis par dizaines !

int.text: Try not to trip over your ego, Warpath.
He's one of the toughest Autobots that ever lived, kid. You BET it takes all this.
Good! I'm itching to blast somebody!
I'm thrilled.
Decepticon Destroyer!  Look out!
Flank 'em! They're not so tough from the rear!

fra.text: Contourne-le ! Ils sont plus vulnérables par l'arrière !

int.text: What's the matter, kid, you've never seen a space slug before?

fra.text: Quoi, tu n'avais encore jamais vu de limaces spatiales, petit ?

int.text: Whoa!
Of course you are. Let's get it over with!
I felt THAT one.
Optimus -- this growth is really unstable!

fra.text: Optimus... ces pousses sont très instables !

int.text: Watch those spikes! They look like they'd hurt a LOT.

fra.text: Attention à ces pointes ! Elles doivent faire TRÈS MAL !

int.text: Something's not right.
I don't know yet...but be ready. Something's coming.

fra.text: Je ne sais pas... mais tenez-vous prêt. Ça approche.

int.text: You hear that sound? ...What is that?
My sentiments exactly.
How could I NOT see it?

fra.text: Difficile de ne PAS le voir !

int.text: The slugs're spooked again.
I don't see either of you. Or the slug I was riding.
Optimus -- there's a release gate blocking the way.
It worked!
There you go.
Wait! No! Why does he always do that?
Next time, wait for us!
Yeah, and thanks for not shooting the control panels first!
I can't be jealous of something you don't have.
Look -- there it went!
Doesn't look good, Optimus. The whole shell's been corrupted.

fra.text: Ça se présente mal, Optimus. Elle a été entièrement contaminée.

int.text: You all right, Optimus?
Optimus, this whole area is unstable. We need to move carefully. Especially YOU, Warpath.
Ugh...Dark Energon is everywhere.
LOOK OUT! It's that thing that's been following us!

fra.text: ATTENTION ! Cette horreur nous a suivis jusqu'ici !!

int.text: Stay away from those spikes!
This isn't working! We need to find a weak point!

fra.text: C'est inutile ! On doit d'abord trouver son point faible !

int.text: The mouth! Shoot it in the mouth!
We must've hurt it!
I don't think so, kid.
By the way, Optimus--its nice to see you step up and be the leader I always knew you could be.  What took so long?
Okay, now what? I don't see any way across.
Don't get cocky, kid--Decepticons never make it easy.

fra.text: Reste concentré, petit. Les Decepticons ne plaisantent pas !

int.text: Ahem--Bah-weep-Graaaagnah wheep ni ni bong.
That's the universal greeting.
Blast the bridge supports!  That'll show 'im!
What about that up there?  Bet we could blast that thing and bring it down.
Status: LIBERATED.
Systems: powering up.
New leader Optimus Prime: identified. Omega Supreme: grateful.
Systems: weak. Repairs: required.
Alert: inbound Decepticons. Defensive perimeter: advisable.

fra.text: Alerte : Decepticons en approche. Périmètre défensif : recommandé.

int.text: Omega Gate sequence: initiating.
Ratchet: disabled. Omega Gate procedure: incomplete.
Omega Gate sequence: twenty-five percent complete.
Omega Gate sequence: fifty percent complete.
Omega Gate sequence: seventy-five percent complete.
Omega Gate sequence: complete. Core entrance: available.
Omega: Free!  Omega: Smash!
Heads up, Autobots! Snipers!
You're about to find out.
We should keep moving.

fra.text: Nous avons une mission à accomplir.

int.text: We're a team Warpath.  Let's focus on finding Omega Supreme.
Omega Supreme! What have they done to you?
Ratchet -- this is Optimus. We've located Omega Supreme. Can you access the terminal here remotely and find a way to free him?
There! Blast the power cells!
We've got company!
There. Unlock the security console just ahead.
Be aware! We've got cloakers nearby!
That elevator should take us to Omega's restraint controls!

fra.text: Cet ascenseur devrait nous conduire jusqu'aux commandes des entraves d'Omega.

int.text: Great work! Just one more to go!
That did it! Let's get in there and help him out!

fra.text: Ça y est, il est enfin libre ! Allons vite l'aider !

int.text: Autobots! Defend Omega Supreme while he recovers!
We're glad you're free, Omega Supreme -- but I need you to open the Omega Gate immediately.
Ratchet, do you copy? I need you here, double time!
Energon! We can restore ourselves here.

fra.text: De l'énergon ! Nous pouvons récupérer un peu ici.

int.text: Keep working, Ratchet -- but be aware, it looks as though the next wave is coming from the sky!
Thank you, Omega Supreme. We'll take it from here.

fra.text: Merci, Omega Supreme. C'est à nous de jouer, maintenant.

int.text: Thanks, Ratchet. We'll continue to the Core without you.
Keep your optics sharp, Autobots. The High Council told me about the corruptive properties of Dark Energon.
The closer we get to the core, the more dangerous and unstable Cybertron may appear.
They're a part of Cybertron's natural defenses. They'll eat away at the Dark Energon's corruption.
We have nothing to fear, Autobots. The slugs will count us as friends.
The Core rests at the very center of Cybertron. We'll have to jump this to continue.
The corruption is spreading more quickly than I had imagined.

fra.text: La corruption s'étend encore plus vite que je ne l'avais imaginé !

int.text: What is it, Ironhide?
I think they WANT us to ride them. They can sense we're here to help.
It makes sense for Megatron to have the Core so heavily protected. It's his most valuable asset.
Hrrgh. Autobots -- report your positions! Where are you?
We need to regroup. Move forward, and stay in contact.
Ironhide, I can see you from my platform.
Hold on. I see a switch that might help.
Ironhide, I've encountered another flood gate. Do you see a control panel nearby?
Now--let's find Warpath!
We see you, Warpath, but we can't reach you. We'll try to find a way around.
Warpath, we're at the shore of an energon river, but have no way of crossing it.
That did it. Keep them coming.
Good work, Warpath. We're across now.
Its leaving a trail of corruption wherever it goes.
Let's get the last of those flood gates open.
Look -- that's the outer shell of Cybertron's Core!
These are sacred grounds, Ironhide.
The Core provides energon and life to all of Cybertron. It pains me to see it defiled this way.
The entrance to the core lies just ahead.
There's no telling what we'll find in there. Gear up for anything.
Don't waste any more time. We need to destroy the corruption and...
It's feeding off the Core's Dark Energon! Autobots -- take it out!
Its armor is too thick!
Look -- it's drawing energy from the Core!
Then keep hurting it!
Give it everything you've got!
We did it. Nice job, Autobots.
We're wasting time.
They won't give up that easily. Reload and power up before they come back.
That's another wave down...but gear up again. There'll be more coming.
Ratchet, we can't keep this up forever. What's your status?
That--is a story for another time.

fra.text: Ça... Nous en parlerons une autre fois.

int.text: Good idea, Warpath. Let's see how  fine  your aim really is.
Autobots -- take cover! Heavy weapons squad approaching!
Here they come!
Brace yourselves, Autobots!
Be careful, Warpath, it may be a trap!

fra.text: Attention, Warpath, c'est peut-être un piège.

int.text: You heard him, Autobots!  Get these defenses online!
You heard him! DIG IN!
Let ME give it a try.
My axe can't cut through this much corruption.  For now, we have other matters to deal with!
Destroyer!  On the bridge!
Whatever it is, its standing between us and saving Cybertron.  Autobots--Charge!
Negative, Optimus. The system is too well-protected to hack...but if you can find a way to weaken their power grid, I might be able to get in.

fra.text: Négatif, Optimus. Le système est trop bien protégé pour être piraté... mais si vous affaiblissez leur grille d'énergie, j'ai peut-être une chance.

int.text: That did it -- I'm in. Hmm...the whole facility's in lockdown mode. Guess they know you're there, huh?
I'll punch up a holo-map...
There. First thing you need to do is hack the Main Security Console. That'll cancel the lockdown.
I'm on my way, Optimus, but it'll take me a few cycles to reach you!

fra.text: Je suis déjà en route, Optimus, mais il va me falloir quelques cycles pour arriver !

int.text: I'm here Optimus!
Keep those Decepticons off me while I patch him up, would you?

fra.text: Occupez-vous de ces Decepticons pendant que je le répare, d'accord ?

int.text: Keep those 'cons off of me!
Autobots! I can't work when I'm getting shot at!

fra.text: Autobots ! J'ai du mal à travailler quand on me tire dessus !

int.text: Hey, guys, I'm getting shot to pieces here!
I'm taking some serious damage!
Optimus! My systems are critical! I need assistance!
One more hit and I'm scrap metal!
All right -- I've repaired Omega's vitals, but he still needs more work before he can finish opening the Omega Gate.
I've got Omega's primary capacitors restored, but I still need more time!
Optimus, I'll need to complete Omega's repairs at headquarters.

fra.text: Optimus, je dois rentrer à la base pour finir de réparer Omega.

int.text: Those control panels should unlock the rocket turrets.

fra.text: Ces commandes devraient déverrouiller les tourelles à roquettes.

int.text: Autobots--Omega is nearly battle ready.  Hold that Destroyer off just a little longer.
Almost there--just need a little more time...
There! It's done!
Autobots! Surrender immediately or be destroyed!
Hit RX 2
Bam!  Pow!
What's wrong, Ironhide? Too rusty to keep up?
KA-BLAM!
Now THAT'S what I'm talking about!
YEAH! Now THAT'S an entrance!
I've only got one setting old-timer, KA-BLAM!

fra.text: Désolé, mais je suis toujours à fond, l'ancien !

int.text: I get to shoot more stuff? SCORE!
BOOM!
Sure thing, old-timer -- just tell me when the pro shows up!
Keep dreaming, grandpa. I'm two up on you!

fra.text: Quelle blague ! J'en détruis deux fois plus que toi !

int.text: Double bam!

Wow--look at the hardware in here! It takes all of this just to keep
Omega locked up?
Time to get LOUD!
Now you're speaking my language, Ironhide!

fra.text: On parle enfin le même langage, Ironhide !

int.text: A Destroyer?  Pow!  That's just my style!
I'll show 'em what a Defender can do!

fra.text: Ils vont voir ce qu'un Défenseur peut faire !

int.text: What are those things?
YEAH! I'm ready!
Look!
Blast your way through!
Huh? It's a dead end!
Those look like turrets on their backs...!
Yeeee-ha!
This place is crawling with Decepticons!
Did you see that?

Megatron has an entire army down 
here!

fra.text: Megatron a envoyé toute son armée ici !

int.text: I'm, uh...hmm. I have no clue where I am.

fra.text: Je, euh... Je ne sais pas du tout où je suis.

int.text: Optimus! I've got the drop on a squad of Decepticons.  I'm gonna take 'em out!
Hang on -- I think I'm at the control station for that area.

fra.text: Attendez... je suis dans la station de contrôle de ce secteur.

int.text: Ironhide, I'm beginning to think you're jealous of my fine aim.

fra.text: Ironhide, je commence à croire que tu es jaloux de ma précision !

int.text: Decepticons Inbound!
Hi, guys! Welcome back!
Wow...
What? I can be careful! YOU be careful.
I can feel the raw energy from here!

fra.text: Cet endroit est saturé d'énergie pure !

int.text: What the--? My shots are just bouncing off him! How is that possible?
Watch out for those claws! They're pretty nasty!

fra.text: Attention à ses griffes ! Elles sont redoutables !

int.text: Is that it?  We won?
HA! It's running scared!
Sweet!  Overshields!
Heh!  Auto defenses--guess we can just take it easy.
The corruption sealed us in!  We're stuck!
Now we're stuck AND stuck.
That stuff is tough.
What was THAT?
I don't think it worked.

fra.text: Ça a pas l'air de marcher.

int.text: What is that?  You hear that?
What is this thing?  It won't leave us alone!
